title: 第14章   先处着
slug: 四合院开局绑定空间农场
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

秦京茹不紧不慢地把饺子吃完了。

外头早就黑透了。

等她洗了碗，李阳问：“秦叔他们晓得你上我这儿来不？”

“晓得啊，我跟家里打过招呼的。”秦京茹点了点头。

李阳笑了：“成，他们晓得就好。你等一下，我进屋摸手电筒，送你回去。”

秦京茹跟在他后头进了里屋，忽然冒出一句：“这早晚还早着呢，我不想回去。”

李阳回过头，见她噘着嘴，眼睛眨巴眨巴的，满脸都写着舍不得走。心里头一软，笑着说：“那行，咱再说会子话。”

得，灶房里火早灭了，只得重新点起来。

要不这大冷的天，干坐着哪扛得住。

柴火舔着灶口，火光一窜一窜的，暖烘烘的。

橘黄的光映在秦京茹脸上，忽明忽暗的，像蒙了一层纱。

李阳见她盯着火苗发呆，神色不大对，轻声问：“咋了这是？”

“今儿到家，我妈跟我说，又有媒婆登门了。”秦京茹低声嘟囔。

“来了好几拨人呢。我一个都没瞧上，全给推了。”

“家里现下粮食紧巴，多养我这么个大闺女，实在吃力。”

李阳皱了皱眉：“你不是挣着工分吗？算自个儿养活自个儿吧？”

“我那点工分，哪够养活人的？”秦京茹摇摇头，叹了口气。

顿了顿，又往下说：“我跟我爹妈说了，说我想嫁你。他们倒没拦着。”

“可你这头一直不给句敞亮话，不光我心里打鼓，他们心里也没谱。”

“眼瞅着我成天往你这儿跑，他们又盼着成，又着急上火，心思掰扯得很。”

李阳在这十里八乡，是出了名的好后生，这可不是闹着玩的。

他不光揣着城镇户口，工作体面，人缘也好，性子厚道，模样又精神。这样的后生，就算一分彩礼不要，只要他点个头，媒婆能把门槛踩平。

不过秦京茹娘家人急得也在理。不管咋说，李阳是该有个态度了。

Page (1/3)

Qin Jingru finished the dumplings slowly.

It was already dark outside.

After she washed the dishes, Li Yang asked, "Uncle Qin, do they know you came to my place?"

"I know, I've said hello to my family." Qin Jingru nodded.

Li Yang smiled: "Okay, it's good that they know. Just wait a moment, I'll go into the room and touch the flashlight and take you back."

Qin Jingru followed him into the back room and suddenly said: "It's still early, I don't want to go back."

Li Yang turned around and saw her pouting and blinking her eyes, her face full of reluctance to leave.My heart softened, and I smiled and said, "Okay, let's talk for a while."

Well, the fire in the kitchen went out long ago, so I had to light it again.

Otherwise, I wouldn't be able to bear it just by sitting in such a cold weather.

The firewood was licking the stove, and the fire was flickering and warm.

The orange light reflected on Qin Jingru's face, flickering on and off, as if covered with a veil.

Li Yang saw her staring at the flames in a daze, looking wrong, and asked softly: "What's wrong?"

"When I got home today, my mother told me that a matchmaker came to visit again." Qin Jingru muttered in a low voice.

"Several groups of people came. I didn't take a fancy to any of them, I pushed them all away."

"Food is currently tight at home, and it is really difficult to raise an older daughter like me."

Li Yang frowned: "Don't you earn work points? You can support yourself, right?"

"How can my little work points be enough to support people?" Qin Jingru shook her head and sighed.

After a pause, he continued: "I told my parents that I wanted to marry you. They didn't stop me."

"But you never give me an honest word. Not only am I worried, but they are also confused."

"Watching me running to you all day long, they are looking forward to success and anxious and angry. They are very distracted."

Li Yang is known as a good young man in these ten miles and eight towns, and this is no joke.

Not only does he have an urban registered permanent residence, he has a decent job, is popular, has a kind temperament, and is energetic in appearance.For such a young man, even if he doesn't need a cent of the bride price, as long as he nods, the matchmaker can level the threshold.

However, Qin Jingru’s family was too anxious to understand.No matter what you say, Li Yang should have an attitude.
